worldcombat.skill.iceshard.summary: Flash-freeze a chunk of ice and hurl it in a straight line: almost instant, it deals physical damage and chills the target so it moves more slowly. It is one light, quick shard: it only shatters against a block and dissipates when spent, leaving no ice or field behind. The shatter form bursts onto nearby foes at a slower, shorter and more expensive hurl.
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.use.0: An instant ranged physical first strike
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.use.1: Pick off a target at range and leave it chilled
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.use.2: Aim freely; shatter on blocks and dissipate with nothing left behind
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.description.0: The shard deals about %1$s physical damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.description.1: Hurl up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick; a landed hit leaves the target chilled for %3$s, slowing its movement by 35%%.
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.shatter.on: Shatter form: the first impact bursts, hitting other foes within %1$s blocks for %2$s of the main damage without chilling them, at 0.85 flight speed, 2 blocks less range, 2 ticks more recovery and 8 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.shatter.off: Single form: one hard shard, fast, long and quick to recover, chilling only the target it strikes.
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.growth.0: At level %1$s the shard rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.growth.1: At level %1$s the shard rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.preference.sh: On: the first impact bursts, hitting other foes within a ring for a share of the main damage, at 0.85 flight speed, 2 blocks less range, 2 ticks more recovery and 8 ticks more cooldown. Off: a single hard shard, fast, long and quick to recover.
worldcombat.skill.iceshard.preference.ai: It only hurls at targets within this distance; it is an instant ranged move, so larger values commit sooner.
On: a low-health target ranks higher so one instant shard can finish it. Off: every target ranks the same.
